ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'An-Naba' al-Azeem' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'The Great News' (Al-Naba' al-Azeem) is interpreted not merely as the Resurrection but as the ultimate truth of the Prophet's message and the authority of the Ahl al-Bayt, serving as a decisive warning to the disbelievers of Mecca. This phrase anchors the surah's rhetorical questions about the Day of Judgment, emphasizing the certainty of divine retribution and reward as a core tenet of Shia eschatology.
